translation.name: Mushog Testamento
translation.englishName: Huamalíes-Dos de Mayo Huánuco Quechua NT

content: Pilätuman Jesucristuta prësu apayashgan
Saypita pasa waraycaptinnami lapan mandag cüracuna y Israel mayor runacuna shuntacaycur wilanacuyargan Jesusta imanöpapis wanusiyänanpä.
Wilanacurcurnami liyarcur Jesusta apasiyargan Israel nacionpa mandagnin Pilätuman.
Judas Iscariote jurcacushgan
Jesusta wanusinanpä Israel mayor runacuna wilanacuyashganta musyaycurmi Judas Iscariote fiyupa laquicorgan. Saymi chasquishgan quimsa chunca (30) yurag guellayta cutisergan mandag cüracunaman.
Cutisirmi paycunata nergan: “Jusaynag runata maquiquiman entregar jusalicushcämi, taytacuna.” Sayno niptinmi niyargan: “¡Imanöpis cacuy! ¡Nogacunataga manami imapis gocayämansu!”
Sayno niyaptinmi Judasga chasquishgan guellayta templuman jitariycur aywacorgan. Nircurnami jurcacusquergan.
Sauraga mandag cüracuna say guellayta shuntarcur niyargan: “Cay guellayga runapa yawarninpa chaninmi. Sayno caycaptenga manami ofrendacunaman talusishwansu.”
Sayno nirmi wilanacuyargan say guellaywan manca rurag runapa chacranta rantiyänanpä. Say chacrata rantiyargan jäpa runacuna wanuptin sayman pampayänanpämi.
Jesuspa yawarnin chanin captinmi say chacrata runacuna jutinta churapäyargan “Yawar Pampa” niyashpan.
Mandag cüracuna chacrata sayno rantiyaptinmi Tayta Diosninsipa unay profëtan Jeremías guelgashgan cumplicargan. Say guelgashganga caynömi nican:

content.text: “Paypa chanin ayca cananpäpis Israel runacuna niyashgannölami quimsa chunca (30) guellayta chasquiyargan.
Say guellaywanmi Tayta Dios nimashgannöla manca rurag runapa chacranta rantiyargan.”

content: Jesucristuta Pilato tapushgan

Israel nacionpa mandagnin Pilätuman Jesusta prësu chäsiyaptinmi pay Jesusta taporgan: “¿Rasunpacu gamga canqui Israel runacunapa mandagnin rey?” nir. Sayno tapuptinmi Jesús nergan: “Gam nishgayquinölami rasunpaypa caycä.”
Saycho mandag cüracuna y Israel mayor runacuna imaycata jitapäyaptinpis Jesús manami imatapis parlacorgansu.
Saymi Pilato taporgan: “¿Manacu imatapis ninqui contrayqui imaycata jitapaycäyäshuptiquipis?”
Sayno niptinpis Jesusga manami imatapis parlacorgansu. Saymi Pilätoga imaniytapis camäpacorgansu.
Jesucristuta crucificayänanpä Pilato mandashgan
Cada watami Pascuacho Pilato cachareg juc prësuta runacuna manacuyashgan cagta.
Saychömi prësu wichgaraycargan pï-maypitapis reguish Barrabás jutiyog fiyu runa.

Israel runacunapa autoridänincuna Jesusta chiquir payman prësu apayashganta musyarmi saycho shuntacash caycag runacunata Pilato taporgan: “¿Maygan prësutatä cacharinäta munayanqui? ¿Barrabastacu? ¿O Cristo nishgan Jesustacu?”
Pilato saycho juzgar jamaraycaptinmi warmin wilacasergan: “Say runaga jusaynagmi. Ama imatapis ruraysu paypa contran. Canan pagas pasaypa mana alicunatami sueñupäcushcä prësu sariyashganpita.”
Sayno wilacasiptin Jesusta Pilato cachariyta munaptinpis saycho caycag mandag cüracuna y Israel mayor runacunapis runacunata shimita goyargan Barrabasta cacharir Jesusta wanusinanpä.
Saymi: “¿Maygantatä cacharishä?” nir Pilato tapuptin runacuna: “Barrabasta cachariyga” niyargan.
Sayno niptin Pilato nergan: “Sayno captenga prësu apayämushgayqui Cristo nishgan Jesustaga ¿imatatä rurashä?” Sayno niptinmi lapan runacuna: “¡Crucificash casun!” niyargan.
Saymi Pilato nergan: “Crucificash cananpäga ¿imatatä jusalicush?” Sayno niptin runacuna masrä niyargan: “¡Crucificasiy!”

Runacuna timpuypa timpur gayaraptinmi ima ruraytapis Pilato camäpacorgansu. Saymi yacuta apaycasimur lapanpa naupancho maquinta maylacushpan nergan: “Nogaga manami jusayogsu cä cay jusaynag runata wanusiyashgayquipita. ¡Gamcuna munayashgayquita ruracuyay!”
Sayno niptin runacuna niyargan: “Nogacuna y wamräcunami cay runa wanushganpita jusayog cayäshä.”
Runacuna sayno niyaptinmi Barrabasta Pilato cacharergan. Nircurna Jesusta astarcasir entregaycorgan crucificash cananpä.
Jesucristuta soldäducuna asipäyashgan
Saypita soldäducuna Jesusta apayargan palacio patiuman. Saymanmi lapan soldäducuna juntapäyargan.
Nircurmi payta asipäyänan cash mödananta logtiparir aylupäyargan rey jaticunan puca-chiclu cäpata

Saynöpis cashapita awash corönata umanman jatipäyargan. Derëcha cag maquinmannami värata aptapäyargan. Nircurmi puntanman gongurpacuycur asipar niyargan: “¡Alabash casun Israel runacunapa mandagnin rey!”
Saynöpis togapar ushayargan. Aptaraycashgan värata guechurir trucapänacuypa saywan umacho wiruyargan.
Sayno asiparcurmi aylupashgan puca cäpata logtiparcur quiquinpa mödanantana Jesusta jatipäyargan. Nircurmi crucificayänanpä apayargan.
Jesucristuta crucificayashgan
Crucificayänanpä apaycarmi tincuyargan Cirene marcapita Simón runawan. Paytami Jesús apaycashgan cruzta umrusiyargan.
Nircurnami Jesusta chäsiyargan Gólgota nishganman. Gólgota ninanga cargan “Calavëra” ninanmi.
Saychömi vïnuta talusergan ayag jachawan Jesusta upusinanpä. Sayno upusiyta munayaptinpis Jesús yawarcur manami upuyta munargansu.

Nircurnami Jesusta crucificayargan. Crucificarcurnami Jesuspa mödananpä soldäducuna suertita jitayargan mayganpis gänag cag apacunanpä. [Saynöpami Tayta Diosninsipa profëtan cayno guelgashgan cumplergan: “Quiquinpura raquipänacuyänanpämi mödanäpä suertita jitayargan.”]
Soldäducunanami saycho täpar quëdacuyargan.
Saypitanami juc tablaman letrëruta guelgarcur cruzpa puntanman clävayargan. Say letrëruchömi guelgaraycargan: “Cay runaga Israel runacunapa mandagnin reymi” nir.
Jesús crucificaraycashgan naupanmanmi ishcay suwa runacunatapis crucificayargan, jucnin cagta derëcha cag naupanman y jucagtana isog cag naupanman.
Cruzcho caycashganta ricarmi saypa päsag runacuna Jesusta asipäyargan umanta awishpan:
“Templutapis juchurcasir quimsa junaglata sharcasinayquipä cashganta nicarga mä salvacuy, ari. Tayta Diosninsi cachamushgan Cristo rasunpaypa carga ¿imanirtä cruzpita urämunquisu?” nir.
Saynöpis mandag cüracuna, Moisés guelgashganta yachasegcuna, [fariseo runacuna] y Israel mayor runacunapis Jesusta asipäyashpan niyargan:
“Waquinta salvarpis ¿imanirtä quiquenga salvacuyta camäpacunsu? Israel runacunapa mandagnin rey carga mä cruzpita urämusun nogansipis criyinansipä.
‘Tayta Diosmanmi yäracö’ nimargansichä. Saynöpis: ‘Tayta Diospa surinmi cä’ nimargansichä. Rasunpaypa surin captenga cuyapashpan Tayta Diosninsi maynami cruzpita jorgunman cargan.”
Saynölami naupancho crucificaraycag suwa runacunapis payta ashliyargan.
Jesucristo wanushgan
Pulan junag caycaptinmi pasa sacacäcorgan malway intiyag.
Malway inti caycaptinmi Jesús fuertipa nergan: “Elí, Elí, ¿lama sabactani?” Say ninanga caycan: “Diosnë, Diosnë ¿imanirtä cachariycamashcanqui?” ninanmi.
Sayno nishganta wiyarmi saycho caycag runacuna waquin niyargan: “Tayta Diosninsipa profëtan Eliastami gayacuycan.”
Sayno niptin juc runa gueru puntanman esponjata watarcur pochgog vïnuman ushmasergan. Nircurna Jesusta shogusiyta munargan.
Shiminman churapaptinmi runacuna niyargan: “Ama shogusiysu. Canan ricashun mä cruzpita jorgunanpä Elías shamunäcush o manacush.”
Saypitanami yapay fuertipa gapararcur Jesús päsarporgan.
Jesús wanushgan hörami templo rurincho saparag racta cortïna rachicäcorgan janapita urayag. Saymi pasa fiyupa sucsucyaptin gagacunapis rachicäyargan.

Saypita Jesucristo cawarimuptinnami Tayta Dios munashganno cawag runacunapis panteoncho pamparaycashganpita ascag cawariyämorgan. Jerusalén marcaman yaycuyaptinnami asca runacuna paycunata ricayargan.
Jesusta täpaycag capitán y soldäduncunapis pasa sucsucyaycagta mayar saynöla lapan päsashgancunatapis ricar fiyupa mansacäyargan. Saymi niyargan: “¡Rasunpaypami cay runaga Diospa surin cash!”
Saychömi asca warmicuna carulapita ricaraycäyargan. Say warmicunami Galileapita-pasa Jesusta yanapar paywan aywayargan.
Paycunawanmi caycargan María Magdalena, Santiagupa y Josëpa maman María y Zebedeupa warminpis.
Jesucristuta pampayashgan
Pasa sacaycaptinnami Pilato cagman chargan Arimateapita cag José. Payga rïcumi cargan. Saynöpis Jesucristuman yäracog runami cargan.
Pilato cagman aywaycurmi manacorgan: “Jesuspa ayanta cachapaycalämay pampag apanäpä” nir. Sayno manacuptinmi Pilato soldäducunata nergan Jesuspa ayanta cachapänanpä.
Sayno cachapasquiyaptinnami lïnupita rurash fïnu säbanaswan wancorgan.
Nircurnami gagacho sayrä uchcusish sepultüraman Jesusta pampargan. Say sepultürataga quiquin pampacunanpämi uchcusish cargan. Saypitanami jatuncaray rumiwan sepultürapa puncunta sapaycur aywacorgan.
Pay aywacuptinpis María Magdalena y jucag Mariapis Jesuspa sepultüran naupanchömi jamaraycäyargan.
Soldäducuna Jesucristupa sepultüranta sapashgan

Jesús wanushganpita waraynin sábado jamay junagnami mandag cüracuna y fariseo runacunapis Pilato cagman aywaycur niyargan: “Taytay, say lulacog runa: ‘Wanushgäpita quimsa junagtami cawarimushä’ nishgantami yarparcuyashcä.

Saymi shayämushcä gamta manacog, taytay. Soldäduyquicunawan sepultürata quimsa junagyag täpaycasilay. Mana täpasiptiquega sacaypa shamur discïpuluncuna Jesuspa ayanta suwayangapämi. Nircurnami runacunata criyisiyanga: ‘Wanushganpita cawarimushganami’ nir. Sayno lulacuyaptenga masrämi runacuna criyiyanga Jesús ‘Cawarimushämi’ nishgantapis.”
Sayno niyaptinmi Pilato nergan: “Soldäducunata churayämuy täpayämunanpä.”
Sayno niptinmi aywaycur sepultüra saparaycashgan rumipa juc cuchunta cërawan lagayargan pipis quichaptin imaptenga musyacänanpä. Nircurnami soldäducunata saycho täpayänanpä cachaycur cuticuyargan.
